settings.d: Required. Address of Miniflux API. Example: https://flux.mydomain.com/v1/
Required. Miniflux API Token. Example: your-token-from-miniflux
Which status of entries to pull?
The maximum amount of entries to pull. Example: 10
Optional. Filter entries from a specific category ID. Example: 5
Optional. Term to filter by. Example: recipe
This will remove non-starred entries from the response.
Which property to order the entries by?
Sort entries in a ascending/descending manner.

text_fr: Ce plugin affiche vos flux RSS depuis Miniflux directement sur votre écran e-ink TRMNL. Il se configure en indiquant l’adresse de votre instance Miniflux, votre token API, et en choisissant les articles à récupérer (par statut, catégorie, mots-clés ou favoris). Vous pouvez aussi limiter le nombre d’articles et trier l’affichage selon vos préférences.
text_en: This plugin brings your Miniflux RSS feed to life on your TRMNL e-ink screen, letting you view your favorite articles in a clean, distraction-free format. Simply enter your Miniflux API details, choose how many entries to display, and customize filters like category or starred items to tailor your reading experience. It’s a simple way to stay updated without the noise.
